import json,pathlib,hashlib,subprocess,sys,re

from i18nlib.config import load_manifest,DEFAULT_VERSION
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime

root=pathlib.Path.cwd(); pkg=root/'evidence/quality/modified-mechanics-repair-20261002/package-009/task'
fix=json.loads((pkg/'FIX-1.json').read_text()); repair=json.loads((pkg/'REPAIR-INPUT.json').read_text()); e=fix['entries'][0]
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
path=root/'mod-tome.lua'; before=path.read_bytes(); assert sha(before)==fix['preimage_file_sha256']
pathlib.Path('/tmp/mmrfix-009-resume-preimage.lua').write_bytes(before)
anchor=fix['source_evidence'][0]; assert repair['fixed_core_commit']==anchor['fixed_commit']
source=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',repair['core_checkout'],'show',anchor['fixed_commit']+':'+anchor['public_path']]); assert sha(source)==anchor['sha256']
lines=source.decode().splitlines(); excerpt='\n'.join(lines[1195:1221])+'\n'
assert 'self:setEffect(self.EFF_SENSE, 5, {' in excerpt
assert 'self:setEffect(self.EFF_WEAKENED_MIND, 10, {save=10, power=35})' in excerpt
assert ':tformat(data.dur, self:getTalentRange(t), 10, 35)' in excerpt
old=e['old_target'].encode(); new=e['new_target'].encode(); assert before.count(old)==1
runtime=LuaRuntime(load_manifest(version=DEFAULT_VERSION)); loader=LocaleLoader(runtime)
b=loader.load_bytes(before,logical_path='mod-tome.lua'); matches=[r for r in b.records if r.get('section')==e['entry']['section'] and r.get('source')==e['entry']['source'] and r.get('source_tag')==e['entry']['source_tag']]; assert len(matches)==1 and matches[0]['target']==e['old_target']
after=before.replace(old,new,1); a=loader.load_bytes(after,logical_path='mod-tome.lua'); assert len(a.records)==len(b.records)
changed=[]
for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(b.records,a.records)):
 if x==y: continue
 assert {k:v for k,v in x.items() if k!='target'}=={k:v for k,v in y.items() if k!='target'}
 assert x['target']==e['old_target'] and y['target']==e['new_target']; changed.append(i)
assert len(changed)==1
assert after.replace(new,old,1)==before
for pattern in [r'%[-+ #0]*\d*(?:\.\d+)?[a-zA-Z%]',r'#[A-Za-z_]+#',r'[\n\t]']:
 assert re.findall(pattern,e['old_target'])==re.findall(pattern,e['new_target'])
# Prove each of the other nine frozen workset entries remains identical.
other=[]
for entry in repair['entries']:
 if entry['candidate_index']==e['entry']['candidate_index']: continue
 def find(records):
  return [r for r in records if r.get('section')==entry['section'] and r.get('source')==entry['source'] and r.get('source_tag')==entry['source_tag']]
 assert find(b.records)==find(a.records); assert find(b.records)
 other.append(entry['candidate_index'])
assert len(other)==9
path.write_bytes(after)
report={'task_id':'mmrfix-20261002-009-resume','role':'executor','status':'implemented','changed_files':['mod-tome.lua'],'revision_key':e['revision_key'],'finding_id':e['finding_id'],'old_target':e['old_target'],'new_target':e['new_target'],'preimage_sha256':sha(before),'expected_preimage_sha256':fix['preimage_file_sha256'],'candidate_sha256':sha(after),'source_evidence':[{**anchor,'hash_match':True,'component':'tome','source_pinning':'pinned','start':1196,'end':1221,'excerpt':excerpt,'excerpt_sha256':sha(excerpt.encode())}],'consumers':{'action_sense':{'line':1206,'expression':'self:setEffect(self.EFF_SENSE, 5, {range=rad, actor=1})','duration_turns':5},'action_self_damage':{'line':1203,'expression':'self:takeHit(self.max_life * 0.2, self)'},'action_weakened_mind':{'line':1210,'duration_turns':10,'save':10,'power':35},'info':{'line':1215,'placeholder_parameters':['data.dur','self:getTalentRange(t)','10','35'],'interpretation':'First %d is the display value data.dur; action EFF_SENSE uses literal 5, independent of data.dur.'}},'scope_proof':{'changed_targets':1,'record_count':len(a.records),'non_target_fields_unchanged':True,'outside_target_bytes_unchanged':True,'reverse_replacement_sha256':sha(after.replace(new,old,1)),'other_nine_candidate_indices_unchanged':other,'placeholder_sequence':re.findall(r'%[-+ #0]*\d*(?:\.\d+)?[a-zA-Z%]',e['new_target']),'placeholder_markup_newline_tabs_unchanged':True,'source_tag_args_order_special_unchanged':True},'tests':[],'plan_deviations':[],'unresolved_items':[],'staged_or_committed':False,'children_created':False}
